decisive_items: duodenal diverticula, wall thickening with mesenteric edema approximately 25 cm beyond the ligament of Treitz, and mesenteric lymphadenopathy with luminal patency
response.rationale: R4 is directly supported by imaging showing duodenal diverticula with wall thickening and mesenteric edema, matching diverticulitis. R2 relies on family history and lymphadenopathy but is contradicted by no GI history and normal LFTs. R1 is contradicted by luminal patency. R4 has the strongest raw-span evidence and no contradictions.

rejected.why: Only family history and lymphadenopathy; contradicted by no GI history and normal LFTs, no direct diverticular inflammation.
Symptoms are nonspecific and contradicted by luminal patency on imaging, ruling out obstruction.
